title: Business Development Manager
description:
Seeking a proactive Business Development Manager. Key Responsibilities:
- Identify and evaluate new business opportunities and strategic partnerships.
- Develop and implement growth strategies to increase revenue.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.
- Track market trends and competitor activities.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
- Proven track record in sales or business development.
- Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
- Ability to work independently and drive results.
